titleEs: Wowhead D4 vs Fextralife D4 — database técnica o wiki narrativa
titleEn: Wowhead D4 vs Fextralife D4 — technical database or narrative wiki
descriptionEs: Ambos cubren database para D4 pero con enfoques opuestos. Wowhead es technical lookup con stats raw; Fextralife es wiki narrative con walkthroughs y lore.
descriptionEn: Both cover D4 database but with opposite approaches. Wowhead is technical lookup with raw stats; Fextralife is narrative wiki with walkthroughs and lore.
verdictEs: Wowhead para queries técnicas (¿qué stats tiene este aspect?, ¿dónde dropea?). Fextralife para walkthroughs y context narrativo (¿cómo hago esta quest?, ¿lore de este boss?). Complementarios.
verdictEn: Wowhead for technical queries (what stats does this aspect have?, where does it drop?). Fextralife for walkthroughs and narrative context (how do I do this quest?, lore of this boss?). Complementary.

useCases.labelEs: Lookup técnico de aspect/item con stats
useCases.reasonEs: Wowhead tiene tooltips detallados, sources, drop rates conocidas. Fextralife describe pero menos granular en data.
useCases.reasonEn: Wowhead has detailed tooltips, sources, known drop rates. Fextralife describes but is less granular in data.

useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene pages dedicadas por quest con prerequisites + steps detallados. Wowhead no tiene quest walkthroughs — solo metadata.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has dedicated per-quest pages with prerequisites + detailed steps. Wowhead has no quest walkthroughs — only metadata.

useCases.reasonEs: Wowhead publica leaks del PTR via datamining. Fextralife solo cubre content released.
useCases.reasonEn: Wowhead publishes PTR leaks via datamining. Fextralife only covers released content.

useCases.labelEs: Lore deep-dive de un boss o región
useCases.labelEn: Lore deep-dive on a boss or region
useCases.reasonEs: Fextralife tiene narrative pages con cross-references entre lore characters. Wowhead se enfoca en gameplay data, no narrative depth.
useCases.reasonEn: Fextralife has narrative pages with cross-references between lore characters. Wowhead focuses on gameplay data, not narrative depth.

useCases.reasonEs: Wowhead tiene map interactive con filters de Lilith statues, altars, dungeons. Fextralife describe locations pero sin map filterable.
useCases.reasonEn: Wowhead has an interactive map with filters for Lilith statues, altars, dungeons. Fextralife describes locations but without filterable map.
